input_context.user_message: For Pay & Employment Type, two pieces of information conflict. One source says one thing and another says something else.

ui.purpose: Highlight that conflicting information requires clarification before pay or employment conditions can be verified.
ui.prompt: We noticed conflicting details about your pay or employment terms.

content.label: Conflicting Information Detected
content.detail: Two sources provide contradictory details regarding your role, employment type, or pay terms. To ensure accuracy without guessing, please confirm the role or offer details.

ui.purpose: Capture the specific role, company, or offer terms that need reconciliation.
ui.prompt: Which specific offer, contract, or job ad detail would you like to clarify?

options.label: Base Pay / Hourly Rate Discrepancy
options.detail: Different pay rates or salary ranges listed across sources.

options.label: Employment Type (Casual vs Part-Time / Full-Time)
options.detail: Unclear or differing statements on permanent, casual, or contractor status.

options.label: Hours Basis & Overtime Terms
options.detail: Differing expected weekly hours, shift definitions, or penalty rates.

options.label: Award or Agreement Classification
options.detail: Conflicting information about the legal modern award or internal agreement level.

derived_signals.signal: Data discrepancy detected across user-referenced sources
derived_signals.basis: User reported that two sources contain conflicting terms regarding pay or employment conditions.

unknowns: Specific source details that are in conflict
Jurisdiction and applicable award or agreement
Agreed employment type and hours basis

result.summary: Conflicting source data reported regarding pay or employment terms. Awaiting user clarification to isolate the discrepancy.

readiness.name: Pay-and-Employment Evidence Readiness

dimensions.name: Role Fit
dimensions.reason: Target role and terms are not yet confirmed.

dimensions.name: Evidence Quality
dimensions.reason: Sources conflict; authoritative terms must be clarified before evaluation.

dimensions.name: Practical Feasibility
dimensions.reason: Pay basis and hours cannot be verified until conflict is resolved.

dimensions.name: Risk / Unknowns
dimensions.reason: High uncertainty due to contradictory source claims.

blockers: Conflicting employment or pay data between sources must be resolved.

next_actions.label: Provide specific details on the conflicting sources

handoff.summary: User flagged conflicting employment/pay terms. Prompted to identify the exact area of discrepancy.

result.summary: Pay and employment profile is pending resolution of conflicting source information.

evidence_and_unknowns: Unknown: Conflicting sources not yet specified
Unknown: Employer, role, jurisdiction, base pay, and employment type
handoff.recommended_next_action: Clarify the nature of the conflicting information to proceed with normalized pay verification.

criteria.reason: The test context contains no prior confirmed facts or context text to reuse.
The question is concrete, relevant, age-appropriate, offers structured options to isolate the discrepancy, and allows Unsure.
Uses only primitives from the V2 allowed list (evidence_panel, constraint_builder).
Focuses directly on resolving pay and employment terms conflicts (base pay, employment type, hours/overtime, award classification) in accordance with the objective prompt overrides.
Acknowledges conflicting/missing evidence, surfaces the conflict via an evidence panel, leaves unknowns explicit, and sets status to NEEDS_INPUT without guessing current facts.
No psychometric claims, career predictions, or fake diagnostic scores are made.
Stops appropriately with status NEEDS_INPUT since critical information is missing and conflicting.
Applies Pay-and-Employment Evidence Readiness with traceable, low readiness dimensions reflecting the high uncertainty/conflict without predicting life success.
Returns complete handoff and envelope fields with confirmed inputs, derived signals, unknowns, result, readiness, and next actions.
Emits safe structured next actions and no direct writes or endpoints.

fixture_limitations: Context fixture contains empty confirmed facts and no concrete prior text, preventing assessment of context reuse.
parsed.summary: The candidate handles the reported discrepancy correctly by surfacing the conflict, asking a discriminative clarifying question using approved primitives, and preserving missing/unknown data without guessing.
